files.title: PDF URLs
files.description: Direct links to the PDF files.

format.title: Image format
format.description: JPG is smallest for scans and photos, PNG is lossless (sharp text and line art), WebP is small and sharp.

dpi.title: Resolution (DPI)
dpi.description: 72–96 for previews and thumbnails, 150 for screens, 300 for print and OCR. An A4 page at 150 DPI is 1240 × 1754 px.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Leave empty for every page, or list pages and ranges: "1", "1-3,7", "5-" (5 to the end), "last".

zip.title: Also make a ZIP per PDF
zip.description: One ZIP with all page images of each PDF, besides the single images.

maxSide.title: Max image side (px)
maxSide.description: Optional: scale every page so its longer side is this many pixels, whatever the page size (overrides the DPI). Handy for thumbnails, e.g. 400.

grayscale.title: Grayscale
grayscale.description: Render in shades of grey (smaller files for text documents).

password.title: PDF password
password.description: For password-protected PDFs. Used for every file in this run.

maxPages.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPages.description: Pages after this are skipped (and not charged).

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
